method: Each role steelmanned its assigned perspective before attack; cross-debate responses serve as rebuttals, root_adjudications as rulings, and the final referee wave is digest-blind.

root_adjudications.adjudication_rule: finding_clusters are remediation work packages, not the severity census. atomic_finding_ledger.json assigns every source candidate exactly once and alone defines the new-open census. A delta is sustained only for downstream propagation, regression, contradictory independent reproduction, severity change, or historical antecedent; scope cautions and rediscoveries reuse prior IDs.
root_adjudications.atomic_ledger_role: authoritative one-to-one source-candidate assignment and severity census

finding_clusters.decisive_falsifier: State an executable iff theorem with all frame, matter, topology, regularity and radiation hypotheses, then make both stored counterexamples violate a named premise or satisfy FLRW invariants.
finding_clusters.error_claim: Live prose and theorem consumers reverse one-way FLRW/EGS implications: x_C=0, zero matter-radiation displacement, or a repaired frame statement is treated as sufficient for FLRW even though current repository counterexamples retain nonzero anisotropic structure.
finding_clusters.maximum_claim_tier: C1-C2 formal diagnostic; no FLRW, global-tilt, geometry, or family inference
finding_clusters.novelty_against_prior_audit: regression and downstream propagation into live manuscript/theorem consumers
finding_clusters.rebuttal: The assumptions are absent at the claim sites; canonical cancellation and orthogonal-Bianchi-I witnesses satisfy the stated antecedents without FLRW, while the exact parent theorem bypasses the later frame-vorticity repair.
finding_clusters.strongest_defense: The intended statements are forward limits under tacit frame, matter, regularity, and radiation assumptions, and scalar x_C is described elsewhere as diagnostic-only.

finding_clusters.decisive_falsifier: Cross-engine equality/property tests must recover the printed coefficients over their declared domains and an explicit factorization or conditional-distribution proof must establish sufficiency.
downstream_artifacts: OMK card and six curvature ceilings
finding_clusters.error_claim: The current theory layer reintroduces a universal NT-A3 floor, implements the reciprocal NT2-B1 coefficient, promotes a linearized OMK coefficient as globally exact, and infers low-ell sufficiency from convergence beyond L=40.
finding_clusters.maximum_claim_tier: C1 symbolic/mechanics result after coefficient repair; no observation-facing theorem claim
finding_clusters.novelty_against_prior_audit: historical correction reappears and executable witnesses contradict current coefficients
finding_clusters.rebuttal: Executable witnesses give the wrong reciprocal scaling and false global equality; a converged truncation error is not a statistical sufficiency proof, and the manuscript resurrects language already corrected in history.
finding_clusters.strongest_defense: The qualitative sign/nondegeneracy statements survive and targeted symbolic/unit tests are green.

finding_clusters.decisive_falsifier: Use distinct symbols/contracts for local and global quantities, bind D2 to a nonzero executed authority receipt, and make TEFF legacy-only tests fail on active ownership.
downstream_artifacts: TEFF active imports and ownership tests
finding_clusters.error_claim: Omega_tilt denotes both global quadratic energy and a local linear proxy, the D2 bit-identity authority has no executable Rust owner in the current tree, and active TEFF ownership contradicts the controlling legacy-only contract.
finding_clusters.maximum_claim_tier: interface hypothesis or local diagnostic; measured global tilt is blocked
finding_clusters.novelty_against_prior_audit: current semantic overload, missing executable authority, and ownership regression
finding_clusters.rebuttal: Downstream rank/reachability and measurement prose erase those local distinctions; the documented cargo selector runs zero tests, and passing ownership tests currently enshrine the contract violation rather than catch it.
finding_clusters.strongest_defense: Each surface is locally typed and the retained constants/tests preserve historical reproducibility.

finding_clusters.decisive_falsifier: Register normalized priors and likelihoods, reproduce evidence with two engines, generate posterior predictive draws, perform genuinely held-out predictive scoring, and require typed authenticated receipts that reject fabricated-ready objects.
finding_clusters.error_claim: Current shared-cause output is a fitted log-likelihood difference mislabeled Bayes factor; its shipped sign/magnitude is not reproduced, the structured-null statistic is degenerate, residual plug-ins are called PPC, channel ablation is called LOOCV, and readiness can be spoofed without prior/evidence provenance.
finding_clusters.maximum_claim_tier: C1-C2 likelihood/sensitivity scaffold; no evidence, posterior-predictive, LOOCV, or Jeffreys-scale claim
finding_clusters.novelty_against_prior_audit: contradictory HEAD reproduction and downstream gate/label regression
finding_clusters.rebuttal: Manuscript and readiness surfaces use inferential names now: +29.7 becomes -1035.461 at HEAD, legacy null means sit near -3893 to -3899 rather than about -3, and authenticated prior/evidence choices can reverse the sign from -39.1 to +26.4.
finding_clusters.strongest_defense: The components are explicitly pre-solver scaffolds and their interfaces anticipate later evidence, PPC and held-out workflows.

finding_clusters.decisive_falsifier: Pool data and simulations symmetrically through the full scan and demonstrate uniform rank or calibrated size across seeds and masks.
finding_clusters.error_claim: K1's two-stage asymmetric rank calibration is anti-conservative because the observed map and null maps are not pooled exchangeably through the same maximum scan.
finding_clusters.maximum_claim_tier: C3 non-anomalous diagnostic after recalibration; never family evidence
finding_clusters.rebuttal: A 100000-trial null experiment at the repository dimensions gives 5.790 percent size at nominal 5 percent; SMICA and Commander p-values move from 0.09695/0.12094 to 0.09895/0.12294.
finding_clusters.strongest_defense: The numerical correction is small for the two current maps and does not create an anomaly.

finding_clusters.decisive_falsifier: Demonstrate finite-sample coverage for the full stacked algorithm, bind a scientifically justified joint measure and pairing hash, and remove unconditional identification language.
finding_clusters.error_claim: K5 stacks an alpha=0.05 projection with an uncalibrated IM interval, MIO F_Bayes lacks a joint measure/IDs/weights/pairing hash, and a historical registry calls response-conditional quantities unconditionally identified.
finding_clusters.maximum_claim_tier: C2 theorem/mechanics and diagnostic-only certificate; no calibrated confidence or posterior meaning
finding_clusters.novelty_against_prior_audit: downstream coverage and pairing sensitivity plus historical antecedent
finding_clusters.rebuttal: No coverage theorem applies to the stacked procedure; permuting positional pairs changes the mean F by about 4.9x, and unconditional registry language can be consumed downstream.
finding_clusters.strongest_defense: The identified-set theorem and diagnostic F construction remain useful as mechanics demonstrations under declared pairings.

finding_clusters.decisive_falsifier: Use a raw-distance hierarchical generative model with selection, correlated errors and matched estimator injections, then validate response rank and joint covariance on held-out realistic mocks.
finding_clusters.error_claim: The known CF4 radial-monopole problem propagates into Omega_tilt and f-sigma-eight; external 428 plus/minus 108 comparison uses a different estimator, and no present response-rank calculation separates local reconstruction from global tilt.
finding_clusters.maximum_claim_tier: C3 estimator-conditional sensitivity; no tension, precision growth, measured global tilt, geometry, or family claim
finding_clusters.novelty_against_prior_audit: executed downstream propagation, injection recovery and estimator-class contradiction
finding_clusters.rebuttal: The 94.155 km/s result is an on-model sensitivity, not corrected truth; it shifts Omega_tilt from 4.073e-7 to 3.110e-8, raw f-sigma-eight moves 0.299 to 0.486 while shell-centered values stay near 0.292 to 0.308, and joint same-data covariance remains blocked.
finding_clusters.strongest_defense: The constrained weights null shell monopoles to 1.1e-15 and recover a 400 km/s injected flow with about 34 km/s RMSE in the audit model; depth-contained central values overlap modern CF4 results at total error.

finding_clusters.decisive_falsifier: Run end-to-end raw filtered-CMB/QE injections with matched mask, mean field, N0/N1 and low-L transfer, then demonstrate coverage over L=2..10.
finding_clusters.error_claim: The entire L=2..10 ACT lane lies below the frozen source's validated 40<L<763 spectrum range, and released kappa alms cannot calibrate the sky-power inverse without raw filtered-CMB/QE inputs.
finding_clusters.maximum_claim_tier: C3 same-release alm percentile; native sky-power upper limit is BLOCKED
finding_clusters.novelty_against_prior_audit: severity change established by release inventory and validation-range contradiction
finding_clusters.rebuttal: The release inventory contains zero raw CMB/QE inputs, so masked-alm injection omits the operator whose inverse defines native kappa sky power; an upper-limit interpretation is scientifically blocked despite process exit zero.
finding_clusters.strongest_defense: Same-release reconstructed alms and 402 local simulation files support a release-simulation percentile diagnostic.

finding_clusters.decisive_falsifier: Apply the recorded mask to data and matched nulls, route real alms through the canonical convention contract, estimate the axis from the declared data path, and calibrate joint covariance/trials.
finding_clusters.error_claim: Planck morphology hashes an fsky=0.788737 mask but does not apply it, the real K1 card bypasses the canonical alm/BiPoSH convention payload, and a hard-coded directional p-value/axis remains externally consumable without joint covariance or measurement in K1.
finding_clusters.maximum_claim_tier: C3 non-anomalous morphology diagnostic; no joint anisotropy evidence
finding_clusters.novelty_against_prior_audit: downstream support/convention propagation and independently reproduced stale consumer
finding_clusters.rebuttal: Stability in one naive mask sensitivity is not a calibrated masked-sky null; bypassing the canonical convention and reusing a fixed axis prevents the artifact from supporting directional novelty or a combined probe.
finding_clusters.strongest_defense: A simple matched mask sensitivity left the current null verdict non-anomalous, and all surfaces remain below family-identification tier.

finding_clusters.decisive_falsifier: Acquire exact-selection EZ/Abacus mocks, rerun the identical estimator including alpha/mask/window and trials, and make all controlling readiness surfaces agree.
finding_clusters.error_claim: The corrected in-house DESI null is numerically stable but exact-selection official mocks remain absent while ticket/card surfaces disagree about readiness.
finding_clusters.novelty_against_prior_audit: downstream contradiction between executed correction and promotion surfaces
finding_clusters.rebuttal: The GRF mocks do not reproduce the BGS_ANY selection, mask response, clustering/non-Gaussian covariance or official survey pipeline, so the computation cannot discharge the controlling release-mock blocker.
finding_clusters.strongest_defense: With n_z=200 and alpha refit in every one of 400 local GRF mocks, p_rank=0.683 and quadrature agrees with n_z=400 within 0.02 percent.

finding_clusters.decisive_falsifier: Bind a row-level raw manifest, consume per-host covariance including shared calibration, require object-identity/redshift matching, and rerun a preregistered match-radius sensitivity.
finding_clusters.error_claim: The 14-anchor rerun fixes stale arithmetic but lacks authoritative row provenance, ignores published per-host distance-modulus errors, assumes shared calibration structure without a joint covariance, and obtains the gain through a permissive coordinate-only crossmatch.
finding_clusters.maximum_claim_tier: C2-C3 synthetic scenario forecast; no observed gain or cosmological result
finding_clusters.novelty_against_prior_audit: executed 14-anchor regression plus acquisition, weighting and crossmatch propagation
finding_clusters.rebuttal: The downloader includes a dead endpoint and arXiv landing pages, no raw manifest binds the rows, the code uses a global one-third shrink instead of per-host errors, and varying match radius from 0.01 to 0.25 degrees changes matches 5 to 14 and gain 1.031 to 1.060; 0.05 mag shared error lowers it to 1.047.
finding_clusters.strongest_defense: The deterministic rerun reproduces 14 anchors and a scenario gain 1.060, and modest shared-systematic variations leave a gain above one.

finding_clusters.decisive_falsifier: Install once into a clean environment and import every public owner namespace from an empty CWD without PYTHONPATH, then make that exact test part of packaging CI.
finding_clusters.error_claim: Two editable distributions claim the htt namespace; packaging tests pass while a clean-CWD consumer cannot import htt.bass.
finding_clusters.maximum_claim_tier: repository-local executable framework; no clean-install reproducibility claim
finding_clusters.novelty_against_prior_audit: contradictory clean-CWD reproduction and historical packaging antecedent
finding_clusters.rebuttal: The independent audit JWST runner and a root-led clean-CWD probe both fail with ModuleNotFoundError; repository-CWD path injection is not third-party packaging.
finding_clusters.strongest_defense: Repository-root execution works with the documented PYTHONPATH and 12 packaging-focused tests pass.

finding_clusters.decisive_falsifier: One fail-closed aggregator must validate manifest schema, artifact hashes, generator freshness and actually executed tests; invalid assets must be machine-readable quarantine and unable to satisfy any pass assertion.
finding_clusters.error_claim: Publication-freeze and external-package checks pass while figure freshness, canonical manifest and VER2 checks fail; freeze accepts nonexistent tests/invalid manifests and the package carries canonically invalid normal-path figures.
finding_clusters.maximum_claim_tier: C1 deterministic disclosure and structural checks; no publication-readiness or validated-artifact claim
finding_clusters.novelty_against_prior_audit: executable false-green counterexample and propagation into release-facing consumers
finding_clusters.rebuttal: The passing required assertions are consumed as gates: current figure check reports 5 stale paths, VER2 reports 15, generic validation reports 31 quarantined figures/98 issues, and an in-memory probe found 28 of 232 packaged figure manifests invalid while failed_gates remained empty.
finding_clusters.strongest_defense: The package is deterministic disclosure, not publication approval, and its prose retains blockers.

finding_clusters.decisive_falsifier: Recursive parsed-key negative tests must catch minified/nested fixtures and all seven final diagnostics must be rerun with the same frozen runner hash recorded as an input.
finding_clusters.error_claim: The initial counterfactual non-leak test depended on pretty-JSON whitespace and early receipts were not uniformly bound to one frozen audit-runner hash.
finding_clusters.novelty_against_prior_audit: adversarial counterexamples to the new audit harness itself
finding_clusters.rebuttal: Minified valid JSON bypassed the lexical test, and a mutating untracked runner prevents byte-level replay even when numerical outputs are recorded.
finding_clusters.remediation: The leak scan covers parsed JSON/YAML and rendered-equivalent Markdown/TeX fixtures; command IDs are atomically claimed and ledger writes locked; decisive inputs, environment content, and captured numeric payloads are rehashed. All seven diagnostics were replayed with audit-runner input hash sha256:614630a438c046418703ec07dd91cf2d305b7ce8962b27904960c4d588c3fa0c in exact execution receipts sealed_v2_cf4/grf/fsigma/desi/act/k6/jwst; ACT remains BLOCKED_SCIENTIFIC.
finding_clusters.strongest_defense: No actual leak existed in 518 parsed public JSON files and every command still recorded stdout/stderr/environment/worktree evidence.
